name: std::multimap<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::begin, std::multimap<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::cbegin
intro:
Returns an iterator to the first element of the multimap.

If the multimap is empty, the returned iterator will be equal to end().

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: libc++ backports cbegin() to C++98 mode.

summary: Returns an iterator to the first element of the multimap.
